title: Tracing Moral Foundations in Large Language Models
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to studying how moral foundations (Care, Fairness, Loyalty, Authority, and Sanctity) are represented, organized, and causally expressed within Large Language Models. It uses Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) as its primary analytic framework and evaluates model behavior using the Moral Foundations Questionnaire-2 (MFQ-2).
